Can a group sit at a table with exactly: Yes. Only a group bigger than the seats is refused.
How long does a reservation last?: We just use the start time. Two reservations clash only if they are for the same table, the same date and the same time.
Can I join two tables for a big group?: Not for now; each reservation is for one table.
Should the date list show reservations f: Yes, every reservation for that date, whichever table.
Do customers need an account?: No, just their name and phone number.
